relevant.instructions: The state lists other coding-agent instances in `peers`, keyed by tag, and a `need` one of them should serve. Is peer {{key}} the right instance to contact for the need? Judge by its work summary, repository and branch, working directory, session name and running agents; apply `criteria`.

criteria.true: Relevant: its summary, repository, directory, session or agents show it works on the subject, code or task the need names, or it holds the knowledge or state the need asks about.
criteria.false: Not relevant: it works on an unrelated project or subject, or nothing about it connects to the need.

match.instructions: Which field of peer {{key}} in `peers` connects it most strongly to `need`?

criteria.agents: one of its running agents or their tasks
criteria.none: nothing connects it to the need
